actions.newValue: The Dancing Bears strip club is failing: ten covers on a Saturday night, one booking next week, while the new club down the street packs in fifty women a night. When the boss's daughter shows up, she realises the club needs a bigger show, in Dave Harris's story about men breaking free from masculinity's seductive cage.
